name: Testing setup
description: TESTING SETUP (saved 2026-10-03 at Josh's request): the garage truss rig used to test LiveReact -- not a show. Geometry from Josh's measurements, 2026-10-03 (corrected the same evening): room 35 ft side-to-side (x) by 20 ft from the booth wall to the wall the DJ faces (y). DJ stand centred on the booth wall (x = 17.5 ft), 2.5 ft out from it. Top truss at 8 ft: the two moving heads above the stand, 2.5 ft apart (16.25 ft and 18.75 ft); the two Shehds 3W lasers 10 ft apart (12.5 ft and 22.5 ft, so 12.5 ft from each side wall), 2.5 ft out from the back wall, pointing straight into the room. Wash bar flush against the back wall behind the stand; the two pars on the booth directly under the heads. ADDRESSING (Josh, 2026-10-03) = the home layout verified 2026-08-31: laser 1, par 21, moving head 36, wash bar 69. BOTH pars are set to address 21, so the pair receives identical bytes and is modelled as ONE slot drawn at the LEFT unit (the loader rejects two slots on one address; the right twin's position is in the slot note). The lasers are TWO slots (2026-10-05): Laser L on 1, Laser R on 75 (the first free 12-channel block) -- set the right unit to 75. laser_profile = trigger (2026-10-06, Josh: lasers are the 'wow', used sparingly): dark by default, 2-bar moments on the drop hit / PEAK blocks / a big wub, J = one moment now, K = held cue. Only the RIGHT head is cabled (the left one's cord is lost); the left head is kept as a slot on a free address (51) so it sits on the plan -- its bytes reach nothing until it is cabled, and when it is, set that unit to 51. Heights of the wash bar and pars are estimates: correct them on the Venue tab and Save. Venue height_m left unset (garage ceiling not measured); ceiling_bounce defaults to 3.6 m.

slots.label: Laser L
slots.mount_note: The LEFT laser: top truss, 5 ft left of the DJ centre (x = 12.5 ft), 2.5 ft off the back wall, 8 ft up, pointing straight into the room. Address 1 (12-channel mode), verified 2026-08-31.

slots.label: Laser R
slots.mount_note: The RIGHT laser: top truss, 5 ft right of the DJ centre (x = 22.5 ft), 2.5 ft off the back wall, 8 ft up, pointing straight into the room. Address 75 (12-channel mode, channels 75-86, the first free block after the wash bar) -- set the unit to 75. Until it is, the unit still sits on 1 and mirrors Laser L's bytes, so the feature profile's left/right colour step cannot show on it.

slots.label: Pars ×2
slots.mount_note: TWO physical pars, both on address 21 (4-channel dimmer+RGB, verified 2026-08-31), driven as one. On the DJ booth directly under the heads: this slot is drawn at the LEFT par (x = 16.25 ft); its twin sits at x = 18.75 ft. Height 4 ft (booth top) is an ESTIMATE -- correct on the Venue tab.

slots.label: Head L (no cable)
slots.mount_note: The LEFT head of the pair: top truss, 1.25 ft left of the DJ centre (x = 16.25 ft), above the stand, lens at ~8 ft. NOT CABLED on 2026-10-03 (cord lost) -- kept on the plan at a free address, 51, so its bytes reach nothing. When it is cabled, set the unit to 51 (NOT 36, or both heads mirror each other and this plan is wrong). Uncalibrated.

slots.label: Head R
slots.mount_note: The RIGHT head (the cabled one): top truss, 1.25 ft right of the DJ centre (x = 18.75 ft), above the stand, lens at ~8 ft (enter the real lens height on the Venue tab if the hang drops it). Uncalibrated: run TESTING.md Test 5 (Jog live -> SET AIM on dj_booth). Address 36 (15-channel mode), verified 2026-08-31.

slots.label: Wash Bar
slots.mount_note: Address 69 (6-channel mode), verified 2026-08-31. Flush against the back wall directly behind the DJ stand (x = 17.5 ft, y ~ 4 in). Height 1 ft is an ESTIMATE -- correct on the Venue tab.
